Anvisningen gäller samtliga deltagare.es: La instrucción se aplica a todas las personas participantes
Anvisningen gäller samtliga deltagare.en: The instruction applies to all participants

texto: Analyse the position of an article and distinguish description, argument and instruction. **Anvisningen gäller samtliga deltagare** means «The instruction applies to all participants». Analyzes the scope and registration of the expression. Distinguish the data of the interpretation, check what evidence it holds and practice a precise paraphrase. Sequence 3 of 3: incorporates this expression and reviews the above.
